answer_text: Vodafone Cash in Egypt had 8.2 million active users, with 2.8 million added during the year.
Business deposits of £5.4 billion against total customer balances of £13.3 billion represent roughly 40% of total customer balances in FY2024.

Zalando - 2024: KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Berlin (new in 2024, replacing EY GmbH & Co. KG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Stuttgart, which audited through 2023)
Delivery Hero - 2024: KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Berlin (appointed by the 2024 Annual General Meeting for the financial year 2024)

Yes, both companies used the same statutory auditor, KPMG AG Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, Berlin, for their 2024 financial statements. For Zalando, KPMG was new in 2024 due to legal rotation requirements (EY had audited through 2023); the evidence does not state whether KPMG was new for Delivery Hero in 2024.
